name: Service status
description: Whether a service is available right now, following HSDS. 'Defunct' is kept apart from 'temporarily closed', since people need to know if it's worth checking back. 'Inactive' is kept apart from both - a service can exist on paper without being delivered.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Temporarily closed
hasDefinedTerm.description: Not being delivered right now, but expected to start again.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Inactive
hasDefinedTerm.description: Still exists, but isn't being delivered, with no date to start again.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Defunct
hasDefinedTerm.description: Discontinued for good. Kept on record instead of deleted, so links to it keep working.
